extracted.intended_audience: television writers and creators developing original series and pilot scripts; applicants and fellows for the Sundance Episodic Lab
extracted.subtask_description: Development and workshopping of original episodic series and pilot scripts within the context of a short, high-touch writers' lab. Includes craft-focused sessions, one-on-one story meetings, simulated writers' rooms, and ongoing mentorship to advance projects and careers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original series and pilot script development
rubrics_metrics.description: The program provides artists with the tools and training to develop their original series and pilot script.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioned as one of the few training grounds for independent voices; designed to help creators move their projects and careers forward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bold writers, expansive worlds, unconventional characters
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lab is a destination where bold writers develop expansive worlds and unconventional characters for audiences who crave transformative TV. (Quoted: “Our Lab is a destination where bold writers develop expansive worlds and unconventional characters for audiences who crave transformative TV.” — Program Director)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on originality, ambition, world-building, and character risk-taking that leads to transformative television.

rubrics_metrics.name: Six-day intensive workshop structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The Sundance Institute Episodic Lab is a six-day program that offers writers the opportunity to workshop a pilot script while developing their writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short, concentrated residency format intended to produce rapid creative progress and focused development of a pilot.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-on-one story meetings
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows participate in one-on-one story meetings with accomplished showrunners and advisors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individualized feedback and mentorship targeted to each writer’s project and story needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows attend craft workshops aimed at strengthening writing craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshops focus on elements of writing craft relevant to episodic storytelling; complements individual story meetings and group exercises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simulated writers’ rooms
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lab includes simulated writers’ rooms to replicate room-based collaborative processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical experience in collaborative story development and room dynamics to prepare writers for professional writers’ rooms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevated creative strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Together, these meetings provide an elevated creative strategy for artists to advance their projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integration of feedback, craft training, and room practice into a higher-level strategy for shaping and positioning a series/pilot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continuum of support / high-touch mentoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows receive high touch mentoring and support from the Episodic team and Advisors long after the Lab has completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes ongoing creative and strategic advice, targeted introductions to agents and managers, and support aimed at realizing the project’s potential over time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Year-round advancement and community offerings
rubrics_metrics.description: The program offers year-round gatherings, an Episodic Advancement Fund, a Spring Intensive, and an Annual Pitch Parlor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-Lab initiatives intended to sustain momentum, provide additional development and funding opportunities, and maintain community and industry access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch Parlor and industry positioning
rubrics_metrics.description: The program runs a Pitch Parlor (annual) to help projects connect with industry audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focused event to practice and present projects to industry; complements mentorship and introductions for project placement and career advancement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for independent voices
rubrics_metrics.description: Offering one of the few training grounds for independent voices, the program is designed to help independent creators develop and advance their projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic priority to uplift independent perspectives and provide resources typically less accessible to independent practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission timing and format (procedural requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions for the Lab open on a defined schedule (e.g., FilmFreeway submission window Summer/Fall 2026) and specific Lab formats (in-person vs. virtual) are announced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must apply within announced windows and via designated platforms; note that specific cohort dates and formats (virtual one-day, in-person six-day) are published on the program calendar.
